items.name: Dangerous curve ahead
items.description: A triangular sign warning that the road bends sharply ahead.
items.whatToDo: Slow down before the bend, stay in your lane and never overtake in a curve.
items.penalty: No direct penalty, but speeding in a curve is an offence.

items.name: Pedestrian crossing ahead
items.description: People may cross the road at this point, often children and elderly people.
items.whatToDo: Reduce speed, watch the sidewalks and stop for anyone on the crossing.
items.penalty: Failing to give way to pedestrians is a traffic offence with a fine.

items.name: Slippery road
items.description: The surface can become slippery when wet, muddy or covered in sand or oil.
items.whatToDo: Drive slowly, avoid sudden braking or steering and increase your following distance.
items.penalty: No direct penalty, but you are responsible for adapting your speed.

items.name: Animals crossing
items.description: Livestock or wild animals may enter the road, especially at dawn and at night.
items.whatToDo: Slow down, use your horn lightly and be ready to stop. Do not swerve suddenly.
items.penalty: No direct penalty. The driver is expected to avoid collisions.

items.name: Roadworks
items.description: Workers and machines are on or beside the road, and the lane may be narrower.
items.whatToDo: Reduce speed, follow the signs and cones, and watch for workers.
items.penalty: Ignoring roadwork signs can lead to a fine and endangers workers.

items.name: Stop sign
items.description: An eight-sided red sign. You must come to a complete stop before the line.
items.whatToDo: Stop completely, look in all directions and go only when the way is clear.
items.penalty: Not stopping is a serious offence with a fine.

items.name: Roundabout
items.description: A blue sign with circular arrows. Traffic flows in one direction around the island.
items.whatToDo: Give way to traffic already in the roundabout and signal when you exit.
items.penalty: Not giving way can lead to a fine and causes many collisions.

items.name: Keep right
items.description: A blue sign telling vehicles to pass on the right side of an obstacle or island.
items.whatToDo: Move to the right and keep to the indicated direction.
items.penalty: Ignoring a mandatory sign is an offence with a fine.

items.name: No entry
items.description: A red circle with a white bar. Vehicles are not allowed to enter this road.
items.whatToDo: Do not enter. Find another route and never reverse into the street.
items.penalty: Entering against the sign is a serious offence and can cause head-on crashes.

items.name: No overtaking
items.description: Two cars side by side. Overtaking other vehicles is not allowed on this stretch.
items.whatToDo: Stay behind the vehicle in front until the end-of-prohibition sign.
items.penalty: Illegal overtaking is a serious offence with a fine.

items.name: Speed limit
items.description: A red circle with a number showing the maximum speed in km/h.
items.whatToDo: Never exceed the number shown and slow down further in rain or heavy traffic.
items.penalty: Speeding is fined, and higher speed greatly raises crash severity.

items.name: No parking
items.description: A sign showing that you may not leave your vehicle parked here.
items.whatToDo: Park in a permitted area, away from junctions, crossings and bus stops.
items.penalty: Parking fine, and the vehicle may be towed.

items.name: Using a phone while driving
items.description: Holding or typing on a phone while driving takes your eyes and mind off the road.
items.whatToDo: Put the phone away before you start. Stop in a safe place if you must answer.
items.penalty: Traffic offence with a fine.

items.name: Not wearing a seatbelt
items.description: Seatbelts greatly reduce the risk of death and serious injury in a crash.
items.whatToDo: Fasten your belt before moving and make sure every passenger does the same.
items.penalty: Traffic offence with a fine for the driver.

items.name: Riding a motorbike without a helmet
items.description: Head injuries are the main cause of death among motorbike riders and passengers.
items.whatToDo: Wear a properly fastened helmet, and make sure your passenger wears one too.
items.penalty: Traffic offence with a fine.

items.name: Drink driving
items.description: Alcohol slows reactions, blurs vision and reduces judgement.
items.whatToDo: If you drink, do not drive. Choose a sober driver, a taxi or stay overnight.
items.penalty: A serious offence that can lead to a fine and licence suspension.

items.name: Running a red light
items.description: Crossing a junction when the light is red is one of the most dangerous mistakes.
items.whatToDo: Stop behind the line and wait for green. Never speed up on amber.
items.penalty: Serious offence with a fine.

items.name: Documents you must carry
items.description: Drivers must be able to show valid papers when asked by the authorities.
items.whatToDo: Keep your driving licence, ID, vehicle registration and insurance in the car.
items.penalty: Driving without valid documents can lead to a fine or vehicle detention.

items.name: If you are stopped by the police
items.description: Traffic checks are routine. Staying calm helps everyone.
items.whatToDo: Pull over safely, switch off the engine, keep your hands visible and show your documents politely.
items.penalty: Refusing to stop is a serious offence.

items.name: Vehicle breakdown
items.description: A stopped car on a busy road is a serious danger for you and for other drivers.
items.whatToDo: Move off the road if you can, switch on hazard lights, place a warning triangle behind the car and stand away from traffic.
items.penalty: No penalty, but leaving a vehicle without warning signals can be fined.

items.name: Road accident
items.description: Quick and calm action in the first minutes can save lives.
items.whatToDo: Stop, make the area safe, call the emergency services, give first aid only if trained and do not move seriously injured people.
items.penalty: Leaving the scene of an accident is a serious offence.
